summary: Implemented Graph.cbd(resource) in rdflib/graph.py (placed after de_skolemize, before ConjunctiveGraph) with the three CBD rules: subject triples, recursive blank-node expansion guarded by whether the result already has triples for that blank node, and rdf:subject reification with no type or predicate/object checks. Added test/test_graph_cbd.py (CbdTestCase) covering the rule 1/2 counts, typed and untyped reifiers, incoming-reification exclusion, blank node in a reifier not expanded, blank-node cycle termination, and source immutability. Tests were not run, per instructions; expected counts were derived by hand. Nothing committed; no documentation page added.
